content.short: Euler Finance is a non-custodial, permissionless lending protocol built on Ethereum.
content.description: Euler Finance is a second-generation DeFi lending protocol that enables permissionless lending and borrowing of long-tail crypto assets. It combines asset tiers with reactive interest rates, risk-adjusted borrow factors, Dutch-auction liquidations, protected collateral, and batch transactions to support flexible, efficient markets. On Euler, anyone holding an ETH liquidity pair on the Uniswap V3 decentralized exchange can create a money market for any crypto asset, unlocking new lending opportunities across ecosystems.
content.meta: Euler Finance is a non-custodial lending protocol on Ethereum for borrowing and lending assets. Discover Euler Finance and other DeFi Dapps on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
